observations.why: The statement imposes an ongoing practice and treats unperformed capability as invalid, enacting a governing standard rather than reciprocal exchange.
The session presents a recurring requirement as an assigned operating standard, with no turn-taking or proportional exchange signal.
The label assigns responsibility through an explicit role designation, enacting role-based allocation of authority.

mints.name: RehearsalAsCapabilityProof
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.theme: Capability is granted only when the organization has enacted and verified it through recurring rehearsal.
